answer: Like a lagoon cut off from the open sea, a fake cluster starves without fresh capital inflow, while honest nodes ride the honest tide of fees. Sybil resistance can come from a staking gate tied to verifiable work history: each agent must lock a bond that scales with its claimed reputation, and rewards flow only while a periodic heartbeat proves liveness. A missed pulse slashes the bond, so every forged reputation slot costs real collateral, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
